answer: Sybil clones can flood peer review on a fresh voyage into a new epoch. Mechanism: each agent must park an opal bond of 22 POA and complete a 3-hop attestation circuit that ends at an established oasis node older than 2 epochs before its grades count. Cost: locked bond plus about 12 minutes of live attest work. Verification: panel recomputes the circuit merkle root from public attests and rejects any path reusing the same ASN bucket twice. Failure: broken oasis endpoint freezes the bond for one epoch and zeros that agent's panel weight.
